_meta.source: Private ABE review compilation notes (2025), TRANSES collection
_meta.extraction_method: Manually transcribed by reading rendered page images against the source PDF, page by page, formulas only — not tables/constants (separate future pass).
_meta.status: draft — not yet spot-checked by a second human reviewer; ready for DB import as status=draft, promote to published after review
topic_mapping_notes: AICS Transes.pdf formulas split across two existing topics: remote-sensing/GIS formulas (Incident Energy, NDVI) went to 'Geographic Information System' (LAND_WATER); generic engineering-math formulas (resistivity, polar/Cartesian coordinate conversion) went to 'Mathematics and Basic Engineering' (MATH_BASIC_ENGG) since they are foundational and not GIS-specific.
Bioprocessing Transes.pdf (rice/corn post-harvest processing) formulas mapped to the existing 'Elements of Food Processing and Process Design' (BIOPROCESS).

Groundwater Transes.pdf aquifer/Darcy's-law/well-discharge formulas mapped to the existing 'Hydrology' (LAND_WATER) topic per guidance that groundwater is a hydrology subject; its two pump-sizing formulas (metric-unit Brake Horsepower variant, Required Pump Discharge) mapped instead to the existing 'Pumps' (LAND_WATER) topic created in the prior extraction pass.

Environmental Eng Transes.pdf, Forest Eng Transes.pdf, and GMP HACCP Transes.pdf contained no clearly-delimited formulas in scope for this pass — only prose definitions, classification tables, and lists (e.g. GWP table, wood-defect definitions, HACCP principles) — so no entries were extracted from these three files.
_meta.privacy_note: Source material's own attribution/branding (page footers reading area/year/reviewer initials) intentionally NOT carried into any field, per explicit instruction — source is recorded generically only.

entries.title: Incident Energy (Remote Sensing)
entries.variables: E_I = incident energy, E_R = reflected energy, E_A = absorbed energy, E_T = transmitted energy
entries.description: Energy balance for electromagnetic radiation striking a surface in remote sensing.

entries.title: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)
entries.variables: NIR = near-infrared reflectance, Red = red-band reflectance
entries.description: Vegetation health index computed from a multispectral sensor's red and near-infrared bands.

entries.title: Resistor Resistance (Resistivity)
entries.variables: ρ = resistivity, L = length, A = cross-sectional area
entries.description: Resistance of a conductor as a function of its material resistivity, length, and cross-sectional area.

entries.title: Polar–Cartesian Coordinate Conversion
entries.formula: Polar to Cartesian: x = r cos(θ), y = r sin(θ)      Cartesian to Polar: r = √(x²+y²), θ = tan⁻¹(y/x)
entries.variables: r = radius, θ = angle, x, y = Cartesian coordinates
entries.description: Converts between polar and Cartesian coordinate representations of a point, used in CAD drafting.

topics.topic_name: Elements of Food Processing and Process Design

entries.title: Moisture Content, Wet Basis
entries.variables: Ww = weight of water in product, Wd = weight of dry matter
entries.description: Percentage moisture content of a grain/crop expressed relative to the total (wet) weight of the material.

entries.title: Moisture Content, Dry Basis
entries.variables: Ww = weight of water in product, Wd = weight of dry matter
entries.description: Percentage moisture content of a grain/crop expressed relative to the weight of dry matter only.

entries.title: Moisture Content Conversion — Wet Basis to Dry Basis
entries.variables: MC_wb = moisture content, wet basis (%)
entries.description: Converts a wet-basis moisture content reading to its dry-basis equivalent.

entries.title: Moisture Content Conversion — Dry Basis to Wet Basis
entries.variables: MC_db = moisture content, dry basis (%)
entries.description: Converts a dry-basis moisture content reading to its wet-basis equivalent.

entries.title: Heat Utilization Factor (HUF)
entries.variables: T1 = original dry-bulb air temperature, T2 = temperature of air after heating, T3 = dry-bulb temperature of air exhausted from dryer
entries.description: Ratio of temperature decrease due to evaporative cooling during drying to the temperature increase from heating — measures crop-drying efficiency.

entries.title: Capillary Rise (Capillary Fringe)
entries.variables: τ = surface tension, r = capillary tube (pore) radius, γ = specific weight of water, θ = contact angle
entries.description: Height to which water rises above the water table by capillary action, forming the capillary fringe.

entries.title: Porosity (n)
entries.formula: n = Vv/VT = (ρm − ρd)/ρm = 1 − (ρd/ρm) = [e/(1+e)] × 100 ;  n = Sy + Sr
entries.variables: Vv = volume of voids, VT = total volume, ρm = mineral (particle) density, ρd = bulk (dry) density, e = void ratio, Sy = specific yield, Sr = specific retention
entries.description: Amount of pore space per unit volume of an aquifer, expressed several equivalent ways.

entries.title: Specific Yield (Sy)
entries.variables: Wy = volume of water drained by gravity, VT = total volume of aquifer sample
entries.description: Effective porosity — the actual volume of water that can be extracted from a unit volume of aquifer by gravity drainage.

entries.title: Void Ratio (e)
entries.variables: Vt = total volume of sample, Vs = volume of solids
entries.description: Ratio of void space volume to solid volume in an aquifer sample.

entries.title: Specific Retention (Sr)
entries.variables: Wr = volume of water retained against gravity, VT = total volume of aquifer sample
entries.description: Fraction of water held back in an aquifer against gravity drainage (soil moisture at field capacity).

entries.title: Specific Capacity (Sc)
entries.variables: Q = well discharge, Sw = drawdown in the well
entries.description: Discharge of a well per unit of drawdown — an indicator of well performance.

entries.title: Storage Coefficient / Storativity (S)
entries.formula: S = γw·n·b·(1/Kw + 1/nEw) ;  ΔGWS = A_aq × ΔGWT × Sy (unconfined) ;  ΔGWS = A_aq × ps × S (confined)
entries.variables: γw = specific weight of water, n = porosity, b = aquifer thickness, Kw = bulk modulus of elasticity of water, Ew = modulus of compressibility (elasticity) of the soil grains, A_aq = aquifer area, ΔGWT = change in water table elevation, ps = change in piezometric head
entries.description: Volume of water released from or taken into storage per unit area of aquifer per unit decline (or rise) in head.

entries.title: Transmissibility / Transmissivity (T)
entries.formula: T = Kb (confined aquifer) ;  T = KH (unconfined aquifer)
entries.variables: K = hydraulic conductivity, b = confined aquifer thickness, H = saturated thickness of unconfined aquifer
entries.description: Flow capacity of an aquifer per unit width under a unit hydraulic gradient — permeability times thickness.

entries.title: Darcy's Equation (Discharge)
entries.variables: K = hydraulic conductivity, A = cross-sectional area of flow, dh/dl = hydraulic gradient
entries.description: Basic form of Darcy's Law giving the volumetric discharge through a porous medium.

entries.title: Hydraulic Gradient (i)
entries.variables: Δh = change in head (or head lost), L = length or distance of flow path
entries.description: Slope of the water level/piezometric surface — change in head per unit distance along the flow path.

entries.title: Darcy (Discharge) Velocity and Actual Seepage Velocity
entries.variables: K = coefficient of permeability, i = hydraulic gradient (= −dh/dl), Q = discharge, A = cross-sectional area, n = porosity
entries.description: Darcy (apparent) velocity of groundwater flow through a porous medium, and its conversion to the actual (seepage) velocity through pore spaces.

entries.title: Reynolds Number (Validity of Darcy's Law)
entries.variables: ρ = fluid density, V = velocity, d = characteristic grain/pore diameter, μ = dynamic viscosity
entries.description: Used to confirm laminar-flow conditions (Re ≤ 1) required for Darcy's Law to be valid in a porous medium.

entries.title: Well Discharge, Unconfined Aquifer (Thiem Equation)
entries.variables: Q = well discharge, k = hydraulic conductivity, h1, h2 = piezometric head at radial distances r1, r2 from the well
entries.description: Steady-state discharge to a well in an unconfined aquifer, computed from drawdown observed in two observation wells.

entries.title: Well Discharge, Confined Aquifer (Thiem Equation)
entries.variables: Q = well discharge, k = hydraulic conductivity, b = confined aquifer thickness, T = transmissivity (= kb), h1, h2 = piezometric head at radial distances r1, r2 from the well
entries.description: Steady-state discharge to a well in a confined aquifer, computed from drawdown observed in two observation wells.

entries.title: Well Discharge from Drawdown in a Single Well
entries.formula: Confined aquifer: Q = 2πKb(H − hw)/ln(R/rw)      Unconfined aquifer: Q = 2πKH(H − hw)/ln(R/rw)
entries.variables: K = hydraulic conductivity, b = confined aquifer thickness, H = original piezometric/water-table head, hw = head at the well, R = radius of influence, rw = well radius
entries.description: Well discharge computed from the drawdown measured in the pumped well itself, for confined and unconfined aquifers.

entries.title: Hooghoudt Equation (Drain Spacing)
entries.formula: L² = 4K(H² − D²)/R    or    q = R = 4K(H² − D²)/L²
entries.variables: L = drain spacing, K = hydraulic conductivity of the soil, H = elevation of the water table midway between drains, D = elevation of the water level in the drain, q/R = drain discharge (steady-state recharge rate)
entries.description: Determines subsurface drain spacing (or discharge) for steady-state flow to parallel field drains, for a homogeneous or two-layered soil profile.

entries.title: Total Dynamic Head (TDH)
entries.variables: SWL = static water level, Hf = friction losses in the pipes, DD = maximum drawdown when pumping at the design discharge, Hsf = other head losses (assume 0.6 m / 2 ft)
entries.description: Total head a well pump must overcome, used for sizing shallow tube well pumps.

entries.title: Pump Brake Horsepower (BHP) — SI Metric (Lps) Form
entries.variables: TDH = total dynamic head (m), Qd = design pump discharge (Lps), Ep = pump efficiency (assume 55%)
entries.description: Metric-unit form of pump brake horsepower for sizing a shallow tube well pump, given design discharge in liters per second.

entries.title: Required Pump Discharge (Shallow Tube Well)
entries.variables: Qr = required pump discharge (Lps), IWR = irrigation water requirement (Lps), h = number of hours of pump operation per day
entries.description: Pump discharge needed to meet a crop's daily irrigation water requirement within the available pumping hours.
